title: The Duck on the Deck
lines: Nick and Dad sit on the deck.
Nick has a sack of buns.
A duck tugs at the sack!
He picks it up and backs up.
The duck taps at his red sock.
Nick sits back and a bun falls off.
The duck gets it. "What luck!" said Dad.
It goes to Nick and naps.

questions.ask: What does the duck tap at after the sack?
questions.listenFor: Nick's red sock. This is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with the word sock in it.

questions.ask: Why does a bun fall off?
questions.listenFor: Nick sat back when the duck tapped at his sock. You are listening for the chain of events, not just "it fell."

questions.ask: Do you think the duck planned this? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. What you want is a reason from the story, like "yes, it tugged at the sack first" or "no, ducks just poke at things."
